{{Quote|If you're watching from home, be sure to stay tuned for Mysteries of Galactic Science, with special host Fez Burba!|Baron Deathmark|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Mysteries of Galactic Science''' was a program hosted by [[Fez Burba]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], after Burba's research efforts on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] failed.
